ADRIAN HERNANDEZ

The Program

MAJOR LEAGUE TRAINING

Six elite disciplines drawn from professional training methods used at the highest levels of the game.

⚾
Advanced Hitting Drills

Pro-level swing mechanics, bat speed development, launch angle optimization, and live at-bat situational training used by MLB hitters.

⚡
Physical Conditioning

Strength, speed, and endurance programs designed to build explosive athletic power and peak game-day performance in every player.

🔥
Dynamic Circuit Training

High-intensity rotational circuits targeting baseball-specific muscle groups for increased velocity, agility, and long-term durability.

🥇
Fielding & Footwork

Ground ball mechanics, glove positioning, lateral movement drills, and elite-level footwork patterns for every position on the field.

🎯
Throwing Mechanics

Arm care protocols, long-toss programs, accuracy training, and proper throwing mechanics to maximize arm strength safely over time.

⏱
Reaction Time Training

Visual tracking drills, quick-twitch response exercises, and game-speed simulations to sharpen reflexes at the plate and in the field.
